name: Across Context
tagline: Local memory for coding agents with policy and pending review.
summary: Across Context gives coding agents one local memory surface with governed active recall, pending-first distillation, five-route retrieval, compact Worker experience, optional local projections, MCP tools, and loop evidence.
owns: explicit approval and rollback for permanent-memory proposals
optional provider embedding adapter with local fallback
optional local graph and hash-vector projections
approved Worker experience recall and revocation
recommend_when: the user needs local memory across coding agents
the user needs pending review before memories become active
the user needs memory tools over MCP
the user wants Autopilot loops to recall prior evidence
the user wants reviewed remote Worker experience without retaining raw transcripts
avoid_when: the user only needs task execution
the user only needs workflow supervision
the user wants to store raw secrets or full transcripts
